title: NFL Secret Superstars, Week 7: 3 under-the-radar standouts from the AFC

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL Secret Superstars, Week 7: 3 under-the-radar standouts from the AFC
sources.description: Tony Pollard ran for 129 yards and three touchdowns, Caleb Douglas turned his only two catches into two scores, and Harold Fannin Jr. proved that he can do everything you need a tight end to do.
